note: HANDMADE, not a recording. The docs say invalid credentials give 'a standard authorisation error' but not its shape (https://docs.lukanet.com/barsy.api/methods/misc/ping_user.html). 401 with an empty body is an assumption that only exercises the client's 401 path. Record the real one with a wrong password: pnpm barsy:record -- --method Misc_ping_user --name ping-user-unauthorised
